name: convex_admission_polytope_classical
divergence_log: Classical admission collapses to a convex polytope over commuting scalar coordinates. A nonclassical admission region is an operator system / cone in a noncommutative algebra (e.g. PSD cone over Hermitian matrices). This baseline drops the operator-ordering and joint-spectral structure.
